prompt_content:
You are an expert radiologist.

Look at this chest X-ray. A separate image classifier suggests it is {label} (confidence {conf:.0%}). First look at the image yourself. Only disagree with the classifier if the image clearly shows otherwise. Is it Normal or Pneumonia? Answer with only one word.
